Machine-readable provenance: `docs/search-historical-contract-updates.json`.

Each updated row records:

- old V1 expectation (previous executable contract)
- new accepted V2 / product contract
- `APPROVED_REBASELINE` or `APPROVED_CONTRACT_CHANGE`
